summary: Expose safe terminal lease repository and owner refusal diagnostics

delivery.outcome: Expose safe and precise terminal lease identity refusal diagnostics while preserving existing acceptance and mutation guards.
nonGoals: No legacy identity acceptance, migration or host lease mutation
No deployment or operator permission changes
No private identifiers or unexpected exception details in CLI diagnostics

architecture.decision: Separate equivalent fail-closed identity predicates and allowlist their static refusal codes in CLI stderr. Retain generic refusal for unexpected errors and test unchanged lease bytes using real Git fixtures.
interfaceChanges: Static owner, scope or repository refusal label in existing CLI diagnostics and settlement reports
architecture.rollback: Revert through independent protected publication. No host lease or runtime apply is part of this ticket.

validation.evidence: Unqualified and foreign repository labels, wrong owners and wrong scope remain refused with byte-identical leases and precise static reasons.
Unexpected private exception text remains hidden; existing release, CAS and recovery tests pass.
Governance, package parity, exact-base/head OneDev, required hosted Linux/Windows gates and independent App publication.
